Author: Anomaly
Name: Eorzea Timers
Punchline: Create and track personalized timers in FFXIV.
Description: Create persistent manual and game-linked countdown timers with configurable alerts, snooze controls, and an in-game overlay.
Changelog: 0.8.9.0 Preview: Overlay border colors; detachable timer overlays with drag-to-dock; plugin update notifications and /etimers checkupdates; opt-in read-only vessel diagnostics via /etimers vesselprobe. Automatic voyage creation awaits identification of the remote Estate data source.
